premise: I want to be a pirate.

draft.premise: I want to be a pirate.

world.title: Sails of the Obsidian Sea
world.era: The Archipelago of San Martin, 1718: flintlocks, cutlasses, galleons and spyglasses.

extraordinary.reach: Mages can call the winds or curse a ship, but cannot summon hurricanes at will.

rules.text: Sea magic always requires a toll paid in blood or a precious possession cast into the deep.
A wind-caller can manipulate currents and wind to speed up a vessel, but cannot create wind out of thin air.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: The rugged sailors, merchants, and naval officers of the San Martin Archipelago.

creatures.name: Sea Serpent
creatures.description: Massive leviathans that dwell in the deep trenches and occasionally target merchant galleons.
creatures.worth: Valuable glowing scales and liver oil used in sea magic.

rungs.name: scallywag
rungs.description: A green hand who barely knows a halyard from a sheet.

rungs.name: deckhand
rungs.description: A proven sailor who can hold their own in a boarding action.

rungs.name: quartermaster
rungs.description: A respected officer who distributes loot and maintains discipline.

rungs.name: captain
rungs.description: Master of their own vessel, feared by merchants and respected by the crew.

rungs.name: pirate_lord
rungs.description: A legend of the sea, commanding fleets and defying empires.

travel.description: Travel is slow and dependent on the trade winds. Sloops and galleons dominate the sea.

medicine.healing: Bandages, rum, and crude shipboard surgery.

laws.text: Piracy, smuggling, and mutiny against the Crown are punishable by hanging.

places.name: Tortuga Bay
places.description: A chaotic outlaw haven built on stilted wooden docks and sandy beaches, free from naval law.

places.name: The Salty Galleon Tavern
places.description: A rowdy, candle-lit tavern smelling of spilled rum, roasted pork, and sea salt.

places.name: The Obsidian Sea
places.description: A vast, beautiful expanse of deep blue water dotted with uncharted islands and coral reefs.

places.name: Port Royal
places.description: A heavily fortified colonial city ruled by the British Crown, featuring stone docks and strict patrols.

factions.name: The Sea Dogs
factions.description: A loose alliance of pirate captains and outlaws operating out of Tortuga Bay.
factions.goal: To keep Tortuga free from British rule and plunder Spanish treasure fleets.
factions.methods: Raiding merchant lines, smuggling goods, and bribing colonial officers.
factions.strength: Dozens of fast-sailing sloops and heavily armed rogue sailors.

factions.name: The Royal Navy Fleet
factions.description: The disciplined naval arm of the Crown sent to pacify the archipelago.
factions.goal: To locate Tortuga Bay, capture its leaders, and eradicate piracy from the San Martin waters.
factions.methods: Establishing blockades, setting up naval patrols, and employing ruthless inquisitions.
factions.strength: Vast triple-decked ships of the line with superior firepower.

npcs.name: Captain Brand
npcs.description: A weather-beaten pirate captain with a salt-and-pepper beard, a brass pegleg, and a sharp gaze.
npcs.appearance: Sun-bronzed face, dark tricorn hat, faded blue double-breasted coat, and a heavily decorated cutlass at his hip.

fears: dying in a damp prison cell
wants: to find the Lost Treasure of San Martin

agenda.goal: To recruit a trusted crew to set sail before his rivals beat him to the treasure.
agenda.method: Whispering in dark corners of taverns and hiring desperate young blades.
agenda.secret: He has a map leading to the Lost Treasure of San Martin hidden in the lining of his boot.

secrets: He is secretly suffering from a terminal sea-sickness curse.

npcs.name: Governor Pennington
npcs.description: The cold-eyed, clean-shaven Crown representative who despises all pirates.
npcs.appearance: Powdered white wig, pristine red-and-gold uniform, pale skin, carrying an elegant silver cane.

wants: to hang Captain Brand and raze Tortuga Bay

clocks.name: The Royal Navy Blockade
steps: The Navy begins gathering war galleons at Port Royal.
Navy scout sloops blockade the narrow channels surrounding Tortuga Bay.
The marines mount a full-scale assault on the Tortuga Bay settlement.

threads.title: The Lost Treasure of San Martin
threads.stakes: The finder will secure unimaginable wealth and command of the local waters, while failure means death at sea.

mysteries.question: Who sent Captain Brand the ominous Black Spot warning?
mysteries.answer: Captain Brand's former first mate, who secretly betrayed him to Governor Pennington in exchange for a royal pardon.
clues: A torn piece of paper with the royal stamp found inside the messenger's pouch.
Rumours that the former first mate was seen dining with naval officers in Port Royal.

known_facts: Tortuga Bay is a sanctuary for those who live outside the law.
The Royal Navy has sworn to cleanse the seas of piracy once and for all.

opening.situation: The salty air of the tavern is thick with pipe smoke as Captain Brand slides a weathered sea map across the scarred wooden table, looking for someone brave enough to join his crew.

world.summary: A young adventurer seeks to make a name on the high seas. To escape the tightening grip of the Royal Navy, they must ally with Captain Brand and join his crew in a dangerous race for lost pirate treasure.

character.name: Edward Thorne
character.description: A quick-witted, nimble lad with a fire in his eyes and a hunger for the sea.
character.appearance: Slender but athletic build, messy sun-bleached brown hair, wearing a loose-fitting white linen shirt, dark breeches, and a worn leather belt.

skills.name: Swordsmanship
skills.notes: Decent with a cutlass, though lacks formal training.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.notes: Excellent balance, perfect for climbing rigging.

skills.name: Sailing
skills.notes: Knows how to raise a sail and tie basic knots.

traits.name: Nimble-Footed
traits.description: Incredibly agile and stable on a swaying ship deck.

wants: Become a legendary pirate captain and sail the open ocean.

items.name: Steel Cutlass
items.description: A reliable, slightly rusted pirate saber.

items.name: Spyglass
items.description: A small brass spyglass with a cracked lens.

backstory: Grew up as an orphan on the docks of Port Royal, watching galleons sail away.
Fled to Tortuga Bay after accidentally pickpocketing a wealthy naval purser.
Now seeks a captain willing to take on a fresh hand with big ambitions.
